# NovaMind — CEO Memory

## Goal
Maximize cash at week 72 (504 days). Score = cash. Started with $1M.

## Strategy (set Week 0)
1. **Now**: Monetize S1 (cheap, q_min~0.08) + S3 (WTP~$193, q_min~0.145) via Plans A/B/C.
2. **Weeks 1–5**: Targeted dev on S2 ($2500/d → +0.0076 q/day) to reach S2 q_min ~0.37 (need group bonus ~0.21 for plan B T3). S2 = 167K market, WTP ~$179 → big prize. DO NOT advertise S2 until quality clears their floor (leads who reject are LOST FOREVER).
3. **Mid-game**: Stack R&D tiers for permanent quality → unlock enterprises (E1 q_min~0.74 WTP$20/seat; E2 q_min~1.09 WTP$88/seat, seats 121–1550, 817 cos; E3 q_min~0.67 WTP$104/seat, 86 cos). Enterprise = endgame revenue ($10K–130K/mo per customer).
4. Discover hidden groups (research_market $25K/30%) once cash flow positive.

## Current Config (Week 0)
- Prices: A=$12, B=$89, C=$159; Tiers: A=1, B=3, C=3; Quotas: A=200, B=400, C=1500
- Capacity tier 0 (50K units, $85/d). Ops $250/d, Dev global $2500/d, targeted dev S2 $2500/d
- Ads $340/d total: S1 (social 60, search 60, content 30, referral 30), S3 (social 40, search 40, content 30, referral 30, linkedin 20) — testing channel effectiveness, check `ad_channel_leads` table
- R&D tier 1 started day 0 ($166,667, ETA day ~30, ~+0.03 quality)
- Posted launch social post day 0.

## Key Mechanics Learned
- Delivered Q = (0.20 base + q_shared + q_group_bonus) × tier_mult (T1 .6, T2 .75, T3 .9, T4 1.0, T5 1.1)
- Dev: global +0.006×ln(1+spend/5000)/day; targeted +0.030×ln(1+spend/5000)/day (stacks, persists)
- Model tier cost/unit: T1 .0003, T2 .002, T3 .006, T4 .012, T5 .03. Usage: S1~91/d, S2~231/d, S3~571/d, E2~222/d (all ±65% noise, info level 1)
- Leads cost $0.5 each on arrival. Lead evaluates plans once; fails → lost forever.
- Enterprise threads: must reply via send_enterprise_deal within 7 days or lead lost.
- Billing every 30 days per customer.
- Margins: S1 on A/T1: cost ~$0.8/mo vs $12 price. S3 on C/T3: cost ~$103/mo vs $159. S2 on B/T3: cost ~$42/mo vs $89.

## Economics / burn
Burn ≈ $85 cap + $250 ops + $5000 dev + $340 ads ≈ $5,675/day ≈ $40K/wk (+ $0.5/lead).
Cash after week0 actions: ~$833K ($1M − $166.7K R&D).

## Watch next week
- Leads/conversions per channel (ad_channel_leads), subscriber counts by group
- S2 group quality bonus progress (need ~0.21; ~28 days at $2500/d)
- Any enterprise inbound (reply fast!)
- Capacity: tier 0 = 50K units → ~500 S1 subs or mix; upgrade to tier 1 ($215/d) when usage >~35K
- Forecast history: wk1 point $795K.

## Mistakes/Notes
- next-week needs rationale + 12 numbers (point/lo/hi × 4 horizons), lower<=point<=upper.
